editorial.blurb: Willow Room is a cozy American spot where attentive service and thoughtfully prepared dishes—from briny mussels to fall-apart short ribs—make every visit feel like a neighborhood celebration.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit up Monday nights for their $38 three-course dinner menu with rotating options like mussels, short ribs, and glazed orange donuts—a steal for the quality and a perfect excuse to return.

topDishes.note: Flavorful broth, buttery meat, generous portion with sourdough to soak it up
Tender, perfectly cooked, falls apart with a fork, packed with flavor
Citrusy, light, cream-filled, unique and delicious finish
